name: Syntyche
title: Co-worker in Philippi
summary: Syntyche was a female leader in the church at Philippi who, together with Euodia, had struggled side by side with Paul in the service of the gospel. Paul urges the two women to be of one mind in the Lord, suggesting there was a conflict between them that affected the church.

keyEvents.title: Co-worker in the Gospel
keyEvents.description: Syntyche had struggled together with Paul in the service of the gospel, showing that she was an active and significant co-worker in the early church.

keyEvents.title: Conflict with Euodia
keyEvents.description: Paul urges Syntyche and Euodia to be of one mind in the Lord, suggesting there was a disagreement between them serious enough to be mentioned in the letter.

keyEvents.title: Recognition from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul describes Syntyche as one of those who have struggled for the gospel together with him, Clement, and other co-workers whose names are written in the book of life.
